description_en: Views alert rules configured for a synchronization task
description_zh: 查看数据集成报警规则
name: ListDIAlarmRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task for which alert rules are configured
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. If you leave this parameter empty, all alert rules of the task are queried
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询特定的告警规则ID，如为空，则查询JobId下的所有告警规则
parameters.name: di_alarm_rule_id

items.description_en: The details of an alert rule

DIAlarmRuleId.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the Id parameter instead
DIAlarmRuleId.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用Id字段

DIJobId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization task

Description.description_en: The description of the alert rule

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the alert rule is enabled. Valid values: True and False

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

MetricType.description_en:
The metric type in the alert rule. Valid values:

Heartbeat

FailoverCount

Delay

DdlReport

ResourceUtilization
MetricType.description_zh:
告警指标类型，可选的枚举值：
Heartbeat（任务状态报警）
FailoverCount（failover次数报警）
Delay（任务延迟报警）
DdlReport（DDL通知）
ResourceUtilization（资源组使用率）

Name.description_en: The name of the alert rule

NotificationSettings.description_en: The alert notification method and recipient settings
NotificationSettings.description_zh: 告警通知渠道和接收人设置

InhibitionInterval.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the MuteInterval parameter
InhibitionInterval.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用MuteInterval字段

MuteInterval.description_en: The duration of the alert suppression interval. Unit: minutes
MuteInterval.description_zh: 告警抑制间隔时长，单位分钟

items.description_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

Mail

Phone

Sms

Ding
items.description_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值;
Mail（邮件）
Phone（电话）
Sms（短信）
Ding（钉钉）

Severity.description_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

Warning

Critical
Severity.description_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical

NotificationReceivers.description_en: The settings of alert notification recipients

items.description_en: The settings of alert notification recipients

ReceiverType.description_en: The recipient type. Valid values: AliyunUid, DingToken, FeishuToken, and WebHookUrl

ReceiverValues.description_en:
The recipient.

If the value of the ReceiverType parameter is AliyunUid, the value of this parameter is the Alibaba Cloud account ID of a user.

If the value of the ReceiverType parameter is DingToken, the value of this parameter is the token of a DingTalk chatbot
ReceiverValues.description_zh:
接收方取值。
当接收方类型为阿里云ID时，接收方取值为具体阿里云用户ID。
当接收方类型为钉钉token时，接收方取值为具体钉钉token值

items.description_en:
The recipient.

If the value of the ReceiverType parameter is AliyunUid, the value of this parameter is the Alibaba Cloud account ID of a user.

If the value of the ReceiverType parameter is DingToken, the value of this parameter is the token of a DingTalk chatbot
items.description_zh:
接收方取值。

当接收方类型为阿里云ID时，接收方取值为具体阿里云用户ID。
当接收方类型为钉钉token时，接收方取值为具体钉钉token值

TriggerConditions.description_en: The conditions that are used to trigger the alert rule
TriggerConditions.description_zh: 告警触发条件列表，支持多条件

items.description_en: The condition that is used to trigger the alert rule

DdlReportTags.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the DdlTypes parameter
DdlReportTags.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用DdlTypes字段

items.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the DdlTypes parameter
items.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用DdlTypes字段

DdlTypes.description_en: The types of DDL operations for which the alert rule takes effect. This parameter is returned only if the MetricType parameter is set to DdlReport
DdlTypes.description_zh: 在MetricType配置为DdlReport时才返回需要生效的DDL列表

items.description_en:
The type of the DDL operation for which the alert rule takes effect. This parameter is returned only if the MetricType parameter is set to DdlReport. Valid values:

AlterAddColumn

AlterDropColumn

AlterRenameColumn

AlterRenameTable

AlterTableModify

DropTable

TruncateTable
items.description_zh:
在MetricType配置为DdlReport时才返回需要生效的DDL列表，包括

AlterAddColumn 加列
AlterDropColumn 删列
AlterRenameColumn 修改列名
AlterRenameTable 修改表名
AlterTableModify 其他修改表
DropTable 删除表
TruncateTable 清空表

Duration.description_en: The time interval for alert calculation. Unit: minutes
Duration.description_zh: 告警计算时间区间，单位分钟

Severity.description_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

Warning

Critical
Severity.description_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical

Threshold.description_en:
The alert threshold.

If the alert rule is for task status, no threshold is used.

If the alert rule is for failovers, the threshold is the number of failovers.

If the alert rule is for latency, the threshold is the latency duration, in seconds
Threshold.description_zh:
告警阈值。

任务状态报警：无阈值。
failover次数报警：阈值为failover次数。
任务延迟报警：阈值为延迟时长，单位秒

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
